high.en: More price pressure and weaker purchasing power; easing may be delayed.
high.zh: 通胀压力更强，实际购买力受压；可能延后宽松。

high.en: Higher discount rates often weigh on valuations, especially long-duration growth stocks.
high.zh: 折现率上行通常压制估值，长久期成长股较敏感。

high.en: Nominal Treasury yields tend to rise and prices fall; maturity and policy response matter.
high.zh: 名义国债收益率倾向上升、价格下降；期限与政策反应会改变幅度。

high.en: Demand-led inflation can support oil; supply shocks can lift both oil and inflation, while tightening and a stronger dollar can weigh.
high.zh: 需求推动通胀可能支持油价；供应冲击可同时推高油价和通胀，紧缩与美元走强则压制油价。

low.en: Price pressure eases and real income benefits; weak demand is an alternative explanation.
low.zh: 价格压力缓和、实际收入受益；也可能反映需求疲弱。

low.en: If growth holds, lower rate pressure supports valuations; recession-driven earnings cuts can offset this.
low.zh: 若增长稳定，利率压力下降利好估值；若因衰退，盈利下修可抵消。

low.en: Yields tend to fall and prices rise; supply and term premia can offset.
low.zh: 收益率倾向下降、价格上升；供给与期限溢价可能抵消。

low.en: Demand-driven disinflation is often bearish for oil; better supply can lower oil while improving real growth.
low.zh: 需求衰退导致的低通胀偏空原油；供应改善则可能降低油价并改善实际增长。

high.en: Activity or labor demand is stronger than expected; check wage and price pressure.
high.zh: 增长 / 劳动力需求强于预期；看是否伴随工资与价格压力。

high.en: Under growth concerns, better earnings prospects often help; under inflation concerns, rate repricing may depress stocks.
high.zh: 增长担忧主导时，盈利预期改善通常利好；通胀担忧主导时，利率重估可能压低股价。

high.en: Yields often rise and prices fall, especially if markets price fewer cuts.
high.zh: 收益率通常上行、价格下行，尤其当市场减少降息定价。

high.en: Better expected demand often supports oil and energy revenue; a stronger dollar or more supply can offset.
high.zh: 需求预期改善通常支持油价与能源收入；美元走强或供应增加可抵消。

low.en: Activity or hiring slows; one surprise does not establish a recession.
low.zh: 增长 / 招聘放缓；单次波动不等于衰退。

low.en: Recession concerns hurt earnings; modest cooling may support valuations through expected easing.
low.zh: 衰退担忧主导时偏空盈利；若只是温和降温，降息预期可能支撑估值。

low.en: Treasury yields often fall and prices rise; credit bonds can fall as spreads widen.
low.zh: 收益率通常下行、价格上行；信用债可能因信用利差扩大而下跌。

low.en: Weaker expected demand often weighs on oil; supply cuts and geopolitical risks can offset.
low.zh: 需求预期走弱通常压低油价；减产与地缘风险可抵消。

high.en: Higher-than-expected claims usually indicate more layoffs or re-employment difficulty.
high.zh: 申领高于预期通常代表裁员或再就业压力增加。

high.en: Often negative under recession concerns; modest cooling may increase easing expectations.
high.zh: 衰退情境下偏空；温和降温也可能增加宽松预期。

high.en: Yields tend to fall and Treasury prices rise; credit risk can increase.
high.zh: 收益率倾向下降、国债价格上升；信用风险可能上升。

high.en: Employment and demand concerns can weigh on oil; one weekly report may have little effect.
high.zh: 就业和需求担忧通常压制原油；单周申领影响可能很小。

low.en: Lower-than-expected claims usually indicate a firmer labor market.
low.zh: 申领低于预期通常表明就业较稳。

low.en: Positive through growth; higher-for-longer rates may weigh on growth stocks.
low.zh: 增长视角偏正面；利率维持高位的预期可能压制成长股。

low.en: Yields tend to rise and Treasury prices fall.
low.zh: 收益率倾向上升、国债价格下降。

low.en: Resilient demand can support oil, usually indirectly and modestly.
low.zh: 需求韧性可支持油价，通常是间接和较弱的影响。

high.en: A hawkish path tightens financing and usually restrains subsequent demand.
high.zh: 政策路径偏鹰：融资条件收紧，通常抑制后续需求。

high.en: Higher discount and funding rates are usually negative; stronger growth information can change the reaction.
high.zh: 折现率与融资成本提高通常偏空；若透露更强增长信息，反应可能不同。

high.en: Short yields often rise and prices fall; long yields depend on inflation credibility and growth expectations.
high.zh: 短端收益率常上升、价格下降；长端取决于通胀信誉与增长预期。

high.en: Weaker demand expectations and a stronger dollar often weigh on oil; supply news may dominate.
high.zh: 需求预期下调和美元走强通常偏空油价；供应新闻可能占主导。

low.en: A dovish path eases financing; emergency easing may also reveal economic risk.
low.zh: 政策路径偏鸽：融资条件趋松；紧急宽松也可能暴露经济风险。

low.en: Easing often supports valuations; stocks can still fall if it signals a deteriorating economy.
low.zh: 宽松通常支持估值；若是经济恶化的信号，股市仍可能下跌。

low.en: Short yields often fall and prices rise; long yields may move oppositely on inflation expectations.
low.zh: 短端收益率常下降、价格上升；长端可能因通胀预期而反向。

low.en: Easing and a weaker dollar can support oil; recession-driven cuts can coincide with falling oil.
low.zh: 宽松与弱美元可能支持油价；衰退驱动的降息可能伴随油价下跌。

high.en: Housing demand or construction is stronger; higher house prices can also hurt affordability.
high.zh: 住房需求 / 建设强于预期；房价上涨也会损害可负担性。

high.en: Often supports builders and home-related sectors; broad valuations still depend on rates.
high.zh: 通常支持建筑、家居等板块；广泛估值仍受利率影响。

high.en: If growth or inflation expectations rise, yields rise and prices fall; usually smaller than CPI/payroll effects.
high.zh: 若上调增长或通胀预期，收益率上升、价格下降；影响通常小于 CPI/NFP。

high.en: Construction and durable demand may indirectly support energy; one housing release rarely dominates oil.
high.zh: 建设及耐用品需求可间接支持能源，但单项地产数据通常不是油价主导因素。

low.en: Housing activity weakens; distinguish high rates, limited supply and weather.
low.zh: 住房活动走弱；先区分高利率、供给不足或天气因素。

low.en: Housing-related earnings face pressure; easing expectations may help other sectors.
low.zh: 地产链盈利承压；宽松预期可能支撑其他板块。

low.en: If growth expectations fall, yields fall and prices rise; noisy data may elicit little response.
low.zh: 若增长预期下调，收益率下降、价格上升；噪声可能使反应有限。

low.en: Modestly negative through demand; broader growth evidence is needed.
low.zh: 需求渠道轻微偏空，需更广泛增长证据确认。

high.en: Stronger confidence may support spending intentions, but is not actual spending.
high.zh: 信心更强可能支持支出意愿，但不是实际消费。

high.en: Risk appetite and consumer stocks may benefit; surveys can diverge from behavior.
high.zh: 风险偏好与消费股可能受益；调查和实际行为可背离。

high.en: If growth expectations strengthen, yields may rise and prices fall slightly; reaction may be limited.
high.zh: 若强化增长预期，收益率略升、价格略降；反应不一定显著。

high.en: Slightly positive demand sentiment; supply and global demand usually matter more.
high.zh: 需求情绪轻微正面，供应与全球需求通常更重要。

low.en: Weaker confidence may precede slower spending; verify with actual data.
low.zh: 信心偏弱，可能预示支出放缓；需实际数据验证。

low.en: Consumer earnings expectations and risk appetite may weaken; not a deterministic trade signal.
low.zh: 消费盈利与风险偏好可能承压；非确定性交易信号。

low.en: If safe-haven demand rises, yields fall and prices rise; one survey usually has limited impact.
low.zh: 若引发避险，收益率下降、价格上升；单项调查影响通常有限。

low.en: Negative demand sentiment, but no specific oil-price forecast follows.
low.zh: 需求情绪偏空，但不能据此预测具体油价。

high.en: Company or sector revenue/profit beats expectations; this does not mean economy-wide acceleration.
high.zh: 相关企业 / 行业收入或利润强于预期，不等于整个经济同步加速。

high.en: Often supports the stock/sector; weak guidance, high valuation or prior pricing can reverse this.
high.zh: 通常支持相关个股 / 板块；指引下调、过高估值或已被定价可导致反向。

high.en: Usually little direct Treasury effect; better corporate credit may tighten that issuer’s spread.
high.zh: 对国债直接影响通常有限；公司信用改善可能压缩其信用利差。

high.en: Usually no stable direct direction; energy producers, chip firms and downstream users have different exposures.
high.zh: 通常无稳定直接方向；能源生产商、芯片厂与下游用户对价格的暴露不同。

low.en: Company/sector activity disappoints; distinguish pricing, volume and FX.
low.zh: 相关企业 / 行业活动弱于预期；需要区分价格、销量和汇率。

low.en: Often weighs on the stock/sector; better guidance or prior pricing can still produce gains.
low.zh: 通常压制相关个股 / 板块；若指引改善或坏消息已定价也可上涨。

low.en: Limited direct Treasury effect; corporate spreads may widen and credit prices weaken.
low.zh: 国债直接影响有限；公司信用利差可能扩大、信用债价格承压。

low.en: Usually no stable direct effect; semiconductor revenue does not set a fixed direction for oil.
low.zh: 通常无稳定直接影响，不能用半导体营收给油价设置固定方向。

high.en: More build or less draw than expected may mean weaker demand, or changes in imports/refinery runs.
high.zh: 相对预期更多累库 / 更少去库，可能是需求较弱，也可能是进口或炼厂变化。

high.en: Falling oil can hurt upstream energy stocks and help fuel-consuming firms.
high.zh: 油价下行时上游能源股承压，下游耗油企业可能受益。

high.en: If inflation expectations fall, yields may fall and prices rise; direct effects are usually limited.
high.zh: 若降低通胀预期，收益率可能下行、价格上行；直接影响通常有限。

high.en: All else equal, often bearish for crude; consider products, seasonality and production.
high.zh: 其他条件相同通常压低原油；需结合成品油库存、季节性和产量。

low.en: More draw or less build than expected can mean stronger demand or reduced supply.
low.zh: 相对预期更多去库 / 更少累库，可能需求较强或供应减少。

low.en: Higher oil may help upstream stocks and hurt downstream margins.
low.zh: 油价上行时上游能源股可能受益，下游利润率可能受压。

low.en: If inflation expectations rise, yields may rise and prices fall.
low.zh: 若推高通胀预期，收益率可能上行、价格下行。

low.en: All else equal, often supports crude; import timing, SPR and refinery changes can distort the signal.
low.zh: 其他条件相同通常支持原油；进口时点、SPR 与炼厂变化可使信号失真。
